note: Local-scale baseline (t5-small-ish, 10k iters, eager mode). Metrics are computed by upstream full-eval over the whole eval split at the final iteration; h@K = Recall@K; ndcg is computed over the top-10 generated IDs (effectively NDCG@10). These are SEMANTIC-ID-LEVEL metrics: upstream generates only the 3-code prefix (dedup token stripped) and counts a hit when the prefix matches, so a hit identifies a collision group (27% of items share a prefix), not an item. Not comparable with the TIGER paper's item-level Beauty numbers (Recall@5 0.0454, Recall@10 0.0648, NDCG@10 0.0384). Generation samples candidates, so values vary between runs.
